focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: Tuning Boosted Trees Without Fooling Yourself
utility_use_case: A researcher tuning a boosted-tree model can export a scatter plot to inspect two numeric measurements for unusual ranges or structure, or a histogram to examine the distribution of one measurement. The utility's JSON reports how many rows were plotted and omitted, helping the researcher notice incomplete or nonfinite values before modeling. Later, the researcher can visualize cross-validation results using prepared CSV data, while keeping the statistical interpretation grounded in the validation design rather than the plot alone.

source.book_label: Practical Statistics for Data Scientists - 50+ Essential -- Peter Bruce; Peter C. Bruce; Andrew Bruce; Peter Gedeck
